ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark) pixels dominate approximately 85-90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized in discrete clusters and linear formations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity (black) contiguous mass. High-intensity white mottling is concentrated in the medial region near the notch. A dense, marbled high-intensity cluster is located at the distal extremity of the right lobe. Scattered white punctate blobs are visible across both central lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a deep vertical penetration. The interior angle is approximately 35-45 degrees based on pixel convergence at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Multiple distinct peaks and valleys ranging from 5-15 pixels in amplitude along the entire trailing boundary, with the highest frequency of peaks on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly upturned posterior-lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular high-intensity pixel groups (rosettes) located primarily in the central-medial quadrant of both lobes, suggesting historical sessile organism attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct near-vertical parallel linear white streaks on the inner right lobe. Multiple diagonal and horizontal linear disruptions are visible near the outer margins of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear scars) on the right lobe; prominent high-contrast white marbling and scarring on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, dense cluster of white pigmentation/scarring on the far-right tip that transitions from solid white to a marbled texture toward the interior.
